**Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |

| 4 | EDX1528 | Ordinary Differential Equations and Linear Algebra - Part 1 | edx | Continue with linear algebra, focusing on matrix algebra, solving systems of linear equations, and invertibility. |

**Path Explanation**

This learning path builds on prior knowledge, gradually increasing in cognitive load as the learner progresses. The path starts with a review of high school algebra, focusing on concepts such as functions, equations, and graphing. The learner then builds on this foundation, introducing new concepts such as linear, exponential, logarithmic, polynomial, rational, and trigonometric functions. The path continues with differential equations and linear algebra, focusing on qualitative analysis, separable equations, matrix algebra, and solving systems of linear equations. The learner then applies mathematical modeling and problem-solving, introducing new concepts such as function characteristics, properties, and rate of change of functions. Finally, the path focuses on engineering calculus, differential equations, and mathematical modeling, applying these concepts to real-world problems in kinematics, moments, and equilibrium.

| 3 | EDX1421 | High Conflict in Law: An Introduction | edx | Emphasis on critical thinking and analysis of high-conflict behaviors in law, introducing more complex concepts and ideas |
| 4 | EDX1764 | Genetic Models for Animal Breeding | edx | Practical application of genetic models and tools to predict breeding value, introducing a new area of law and its practical application |
| 5 | EDX2340 | Evaluating Animal Breeding Programmes | edx | Building on prior knowledge and skills, evaluating breeding programmes and genetic diversity, with a focus on practical application |
| 6 | EDX2853 | Basic Japanese Civil Law | edx | Introduction to a new area of law, basic Japanese civil law, with a focus on structure, justice system, and contemporary problems |
| 7 | EDX3100 | Introduction to American Civics: Presented by Zero-L | edx | Understanding of the design of the U.S. government and the distinctive roles of the Legislative, Executive, and Judicial Branches |
| 8 | EDX3225 | Business Sustainability Management | edx | Practical sustainability action plan to overcome barriers and aid in seizing opportunities associated with creating a sustainable business |
| 9 | EDX3242 | Negotiation Strategies | edx | Collaborative negotiation techniques and question-asking tools to understand the needs of your negotiation partner and maximize value for both parties |
| 10 | EDX3276 | Commercial and Contract Law | edx | Ability to read, interpret, and draft contracts within the South African business landscape, with a focus on practical application |
| 11 | EDX3303 | Negotiation and Conflict Resolution | edx | Ability to identify the causes of workplace conflict and recommend sustainable solutions, with a focus on practical application |
| 12 | EDX3364 | Paralegal Practitioner | edx | Wide-ranging knowledge of South African law and legal procedures, with a focus on practical application and skills development |

The learning path is designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to law and legal reasoning for a non-lawyer, progressing from foundational to advanced concepts. The path starts with a clear and concise introduction to the basics of law, including the structure of legal systems, key concepts, and fundamental principles. It then builds on this understanding, introducing more complex concepts and ideas, such as international law, high conflict in law, and negotiation strategies. The path also covers practical application of legal concepts, including evaluating animal breeding programmes, basic Japanese civil law, and commercial and contract law. Finally, the path concludes with a focus on practical application and skills development, including negotiation and conflict resolution, and paralegal practice.
